charts.title: NVIDIA quarterly revenue
charts.note: Company-wide revenue, not an estimate of AI spending. Q2 FY2027 ended 26 July 2026. Fiscal quarters are not calendar quarters. Values transcribed from the release table; no forecast included.

charts.title: UK business AI adoption, survey waves
charts.note: Businesses reporting use of at least one AI technology. The 2026 wave interviewed 3,503 businesses from 7 January to 21 April, published 29 October. This is not a November measurement. Survey estimates, not a census or a causal productivity measure; uncertainty intervals are not supplied in this summary chart.
